description: SCREEN-E3 (SCREEN-E3-A/B) for ENGINE-3 (PR #6 candidate, 733de4e5...): exploratory screening vs topple-0.1.1 on the registered Batch A suite, 60 openings x 1 paired rep x AB/BA = 120 games (60 shards x 2), TC 40/15, seed 20261211.
